source: Land Transport Authority dataset published on data.gov.sg

licence.name: Singapore Open Data Licence
licence.attribution: Contains information from "COE Bidding Results / Prices" accessed from data.gov.sg, which is made available under the terms of the Singapore Open Data Licence version 1.0 (https://data.gov.sg/open-data-licence).

transformationPolicy: No source values are cleaned, normalized, renamed, reshaped, deduplicated, or sorted. Rows are the exact lines served by the data.gov.sg download API, copied byte for byte in source order; the only permitted change is the documented sampling rule below.
sampling: None. The full source file is within the browser demo limits (1.5 MB and 10,000 data rows), so the CSV is byte-identical to the download.
shape: Long time series, one row per month, bidding exercise and vehicle category (two exercises per month). Some bid counts are quoted strings with thousands separators such as "1,034".
